name: Fieldset
description: Groups related form controls under a caption, such as the fields of an address or a set of radio buttons. Use it whenever several controls answer one question or belong together.
summary: Groups related form controls under a legend

elements.name: Legend
elements.description: Caption for the group; the first child of the fieldset

elements.name: Hint
elements.description: Guidance for the whole group, linked with aria-describedby

elements.name: Controls
elements.description: The inputs in the group, each with its own Label

elements.name: Error message
elements.description: Group-level error, such as "Choose a delivery option"

elements.name: Border
elements.description: Visual frame; can be removed with CSS without losing the grouping

variants.caption: No border — legend styled as a heading
Inline row — day, month and year fields
Hint — guidance above a set of radio buttons

usageNotes: Use a Fieldset for checkboxes or radio buttons that answer one question, and for groups like an address or a date of birth. A Radio group is built on one.
Keep the <legend> short, since screen readers may repeat it with each control in the group. Put longer guidance in a hint linked with aria-describedby.
When the group is the only question on the page, the legend can contain the page's <h1> so the heading isn't read twice.
Setting disabled on the fieldset disables every control inside it.
Don't wrap a single control in a fieldset; a Label is enough. Avoid nesting fieldsets, which makes the announced names long and confusing.
